admissionInfo.text: Portfolio review required for students seeking the AAS - Art and Design - Graphic Design or Illustration emphasis (The Portfolio Review occurs after the required coursework is completed. Students who do not pass the review may apply the first year of coursework to the AA or AS in Art & Design. Specific requirements are found on the department website.)
